summary.text: Dave Hinman is a Republican state representative from O'Fallon, Missouri, who has represented House District 103 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Don Crozier.
He is a former QuikTrip retail manager and longtime O'Fallon city official.

paragraphs.text: Hinman was born in Alabama and raised in Iowa, graduated from Ankeny High School, and earned a B.S. in hotel, restaurant, and institution management from Iowa State University in 1988.
His career experience includes working at QuikTrip Corporation as a retail manager; in a Ballotpedia survey he said he retired after 35 years in the local customer service industry.

Hinman served as an O'Fallon alderman and councilman, as a commissioner on the City of O'Fallon Planning and Zoning Commission, as a member of the board of directors of the O'Fallon Fire Protection District, and as president of the St. Charles County Municipal League.
He assumed office in the Missouri House of Representatives on January 4, 2023, succeeding John Wiemann.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Insurance, Financial Institutions, Emerging Issues, and Local Government, which he chairs.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Hinman said his priorities include putting more money in residents' pockets, fully funding schools while supporting options for families, and legislation for seniors and veterans, and that he is passionate about public safety, local government, insurance and banking.
